summary: Tested ND Risk Assessment Timeline feature (Recharts chart on Result page + stepped card on Dashboard). Backend GET /api/nd-risk/assessments/me returns items newest-first with all required fields (assessment_id, created_at, scoring.tier/total_score/threat_score/vulnerability_score). Dashboard card renders for parent1 (has assessments) and self-hides for parent2 (0 assessments) — all required data-testids present (nd-risk-timeline-card, nd-risk-timeline-card-latest-tier, nd-risk-timeline-card-trend, nd-risk-timeline-step-0/1/2, capped at 3 rows). Card link includes #timeline anchor. Result page timeline section renders with header stat grid (nd-timeline-latest-tier=Medium, nd-timeline-lifetime-delta, nd-timeline-reassess-cta→/nd-risk-assessment), Recharts LineChart with 4 tier-band ReferenceAreas, 6 line dots for 6 assessments, and 5 delta cards (n-1). Feature is production-ready.

integration_issues.flow: Result page for a nonexistent/invalid assessment_id
integration_issues.issue: Result page renders page-level 'Assessment not found' error and short-circuits before mounting <NDRiskTimeline/>. The NDRiskTimeline component's nd-timeline-empty prompt (with 'Take your first assessment' CTA) is therefore unreachable via /nd-risk-assessment/result/:aid — even though the review request expected it to show for users with 0 assessments navigating there. Not blocking (parent2 flow never reaches this route via the UI because dashboard card is hidden), but the empty-prompt code path is effectively dead code on this page. Consider mounting NDRiskTimeline in a fallback block when the aid fetch 404s, or route zero-assessment users to /nd-risk-assessment instead.

action_items: OPTIONAL: Update the review-request expectation numbers OR trim the parent1 seed. The seeded ND Risk assessments for parent1@test.com is 6, not 3 as stated in the request. Result page now shows lifetime delta of -10 pts (16→6) and 5 delta cards. All timeline math is internally consistent — the 3-assessment/-3-pts/2-delta-card expectation in the brief is stale.

OPTIONAL: Ensure the NDRiskTimeline empty-state (nd-timeline-empty) is reachable — currently the Result page's parent bails on 404 before it mounts, so the empty prompt only renders in the (unreachable) case where the assessment loads but items[] is empty.
critical_code_review_comments: NDRiskTimeline.jsx / NDRiskTimelineCard.jsx both re-declare TIER_META locally — extract into /lib/ndRiskTiers.js to keep tier colors/labels in one place (DRY).

NDRiskTimelineCard hides itself while loading (items===null) which is fine for first-time visitors but hides a valid card for a brief moment on every dashboard load. A tiny skeleton (e.g., 40px placeholder) would prevent layout shift.

The hash anchor #timeline does not visibly scroll on direct load in Playwright (scrollY stayed 0). Recharts inside a still-mounting ResponsiveContainer can cause the target section to move after the initial scroll. Consider a useEffect on the Result page that scrollIntoView()s the #timeline element once data is loaded.
